completion_data.completion_summary: Added /distill --dream as an 8th sub-mode: ingests the unified event store via events-query.sh, correlates events to memories (task-number match then keyword overlap), classifies corroborated/contradicted/gap, revises the vault through existing UPDATE/EXTEND/CREATE/tombstone primitives behind a mandatory AskUserQuestion stop, and surfaces a separate improvement-proposal deliverable. Documentation-only change across six memory-extension files; agent-system/extensions/core/ untouched.

memory_candidates.content: When adding a new mutually-exclusive flag to an existing if/elif dispatch chain plus a user-facing numbered prose list (e.g. /distill's sub-mode dispatch), the code-chain insertion point and the prose-list position can differ without semantic conflict, since first-match-wins only matters when flags could co-occur ambiguously. Insert in the code chain wherever logically grouped (e.g. next to a related flag); append to the prose list at the end if that reads more naturally as 'newest addition'.

To verify a no-task-references-in-deliverables rule check without false positives from pre-existing violations, scope the check to the task's own commit range (git diff <base>..HEAD -- <touched-files>) rather than the whole working tree diff, and filter added lines only (git diff | grep '^+'). Unchanged pre-existing violating rows in the same file will otherwise show up as false failures.

.claude/ (and .opencode/) are gitignored deploy targets synced from agent-system/extensions/*/ source -- git-based before/after worktree comparisons of check-extension-docs.sh cannot see them. To confirm a doc-lint FAIL is pre-existing rather than caused by the current task, use git log/git status --porcelain scoped to the source extension directories instead of a git worktree checkout of an older commit.
